newsitem.title: USA: Tosco restarts 140,000 bpd NJ cat cracker.
newsitem.headline: Tosco restarts 140,000 bpd NJ cat cracker.

text.p: Tosco Corp restarted its 140,000 barrels per day (bpd) catalytic cracker at its Bayway refinery in Linden, N.J., between Wednesday afternoon and Thursday, a state regulator said.

The unit, the largest cat cracker in the world, was shut down in early January to undergo maintenance following a fire-related outage in early December. The refinery has a total capacity of 290,000 bpd.
Tosco officials were not immediately available to comment on the restart.

The cracker's outage offered strong support over the past three weeks for New York Harbor gasoline grades, but differentials firmed at least 0.50 cent Thursday despite the cracker's return. Market traders attributed the firmness to tight supplies of conventional unleaded barrels.

Tosco owns four refineries, two on East Coast, and two on West Coast, and operates network of 4,000 retail stores -- including a chain of 2,500 Circle K convenience stores acquired in 1996 for $700 million.
